title: Do two permutations commute?
why: Natural CC question; reduction tight up to log factor; no known structural shortcut; plausibly open and accessible.

title: Information-tight sorting of pattern classes
why: Fine-grained information-theoretic sorting for permutation classes; Opler's O(n) leaves the 2n slack; crisp and new.

title: Egyptian fractions with k terms
why: Complexity of Egyptian-fraction decomposition with k terms; natural, NP membership unclear; modest importance.

title: Fewest presses in Lights Out
why: Min-weight coset for Lights Out matrix; nullity data verified (d(527)=350, d(495)=320); clean structured coding question.

title: Sorting by swap-or-rotate
why: Distance in a specific Cayley graph of S_n; sits beside known diameter conjecture for (12),(12..n); hardness unclear.

title: Roots modulo almost every prime
why: Complexity of testing intersective polynomials; decidable via Chebotarev, P/NP status plausibly open; tied to Galois group computation.

title: Kolakoski in polylogarithmic time
why: Fast Kolakoski term computation; would require major structural insight into a notorious sequence; clean but folklore-adjacent.

title: Hamiltonian cycles of the grid are #P₁-complete
why: #P1-completeness of a single natural sequence; no known technique for such results; may be false; very hard.

title: How hard is the hat guessing number?
why: Complexity of hat guessing number posed by Butler et al.; Latala-Blazewicz et al. note no hardness results known.

title: Proof complexity of the sensitivity theorem
why: Proof complexity of Huang's spectral argument; fresh, natural benchmark formula; resolution/CP/SOS bounds all interesting.

title: Steiner triple systems in polynomial calculus
why: Characteristic-mismatch PC lower bounds for STS; close to known Count_q results, likely within reach of known methods.

title: Computable connective constants
why: Computability of connective constants of Cayley graphs with solvable word problem; natural, novel, possibly counterexample via encoding.

title: The exact constant for Greater-Than
why: Exact constant for GT randomized CC; Theta(log n) known, constant not; somewhat narrow refinement.

title: Constructive near-transversals
why: Algorithmic Montgomery transversals; randomized version likely follows from inspecting absorption proof; derandomization is routine-ish.

title: Deterministic zero test for recurrence terms
why: Deterministic zero-test of recurrence term at binary index; derandomization of restricted EquSLP/PIT; hard, clean.

title: Colouring Cayley graphs of the plane lattice
why: Decidability of k-colourability of Z^2 Cayley graphs; periodicity question like tiling problems; natural, interesting.

title: FRACTRAN with few fractions
why: Minimal FRACTRAN undecidability threshold; HALT_2 is a 2-rule priority VASS, likely decidable with effort.

title: The monadic theory of the Kolakoski word
why: MSO/FO decidability for Kolakoski predicate; by Semenov/Elgot-Rabin needs effective recurrence, itself unknown.

title: How much of the real quadratic family is chaotic?
why: Computability of measure of real hyperbolic quadratic parameters; natural computable-analysis question in real dynamics.

title: Symmetric numerical semigroups
why: Complexity of symmetry testing for numerical semigroups; natural companion to NP-hard Frobenius; plausibly open.

title: Rational rotation numbers of piecewise-linear circle maps
why: Decide rationality of rotation number for rational PL circle homeos; c.e. one side; natural, Thompson-group related.

title: Deciding limit cycles
why: Decidability of limit-cycle existence for polynomial planar fields; natural, hard, Hilbert-16-adjacent; may be implicitly folklore.

title: Proof complexity of Erdős–Ko–Rado
why: Proof complexity of EKR via Katona averaging; same template as sensitivity item; reasonable but less distinctive.

title: Merging one list into a list twice as long
why: Classical merging M(m,2m); Hwang 3m-2, arXiv:1610.03266 gives 3m-3; asymptotic ratio-2 constant appears open.

title: Constructive Kemnitz–Reiher
why: Polytime Kemnitz/Reiher zero-sum search; lies in PPA_p (Chevalley-Warning, Goos et al.); FP status open.

title: Is the knot crossing number NP-hard?
why: NP-hardness of knot crossing number is a well-known open question (e.g. Lackenby's surveys); not new.

title: Counting distinct subset sums
why: Toda-Watanabe: #.PH is in FP^#P[1], so |Sigma(a)| in FP^#P; #P-hardness then gives #.NP-hardness under Turing reductions.

title: Communication complexity of polynomial coprimality
why: Randomized CC of coprimality in F2[x]; log-factor gap; same template as permutation-commute item; plausibly open.

title: Complexity of the Davenport constant
why: Complexity of Davenport constant from invariants; natural given no formula for rank >=3; plausibly open.

title: Does the Mandelbrot set define the integers?
why: int(M)∩R dense (real hyperbolicity density), complement nowhere dense of positive measure; Fornasiero-Hieronymi-Miller dichotomy defines Z.
